content:
marco: Quick sync / new customer story with NorthStar Analytics recorded this morning. They gave a sharp hero line and want logo+headshot. Ask: embargo until 2026-04-15 09:00 PDT, signed permission, and legal check for the comparative metric.

leah: Quote candidate: "Redwood made inference predictable across our fleet  and we cut per-inference spend by about 38% in production." Safe to use?

ivy: Nice. I'll assemble a short landing + long-form, 3 social tiles, and a 30s highlight audio clip. Planning an A/B hero test post-publish for 72h (tech vs impact).

celeste: Legal: attach the transcript and the proposed public attribution (name+title). If we use a precise percentage we need the baseline/time window (e.g., 90d avg). Otherwise recommend ~38% or "around 40%". Also need the signed permission PDF referencing the embargo timestamp. I can do a quick redline within 24h of receiving docs.

upload-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/northstar-2026-03-30/transcript.v1.txt

leah: Attribution: "Ravi Kapoor, CTO, NorthStar Analytics". They prefer no email published. I'll send the permission PDF for signature today.

noel: Lead routing plan: case study page contains HubSpot form variant -> set property cs_source=northstar -> add to list `cs:webinar-northstar` -> tag `cs:northstar-hot` if RSVP clicked -> route to Salesforce queue "CS - NorthStar". Also add utm_campaign=cs_northstar_apr and cookie expiry 30d. Any objections?

ivy: Can we also add a hidden input for pipeline_channel=content_e_book to help track downstream plays?

noel: Yep, will include hidden `pipeline_channel=cs_case` and set cookie for 30d. I'll also add a tiny playbook for SDRs in the SF queue description that prioritizes `cs:northstar-hot` for webinar invites.

marco: Timeline: Ivy drafts by Thu EOD, Legal redline Mon, final approval Tue, publish Wed 2026-04-15. Webinar tentative 2026-04-29. Is that realistic?

celeste: Monday redline fine if permission + transcript + attribution are final today. Otherwise it slips. Please ensure the permission PDF includes the embargo lift timestamp explicitly.

leah: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/northstar/permission-signed-2026-03-30.pdf

celeste: Received. I'll post comments by Mon 11:00 PDT. If numeric language is uncertain, I'll recommend changing to "~38%".

ivy: Draft plan for assets:
- short landing (500-700 words)
- long-form case study (1200+ words)
- 3 social tiles + 1 short clip (30s)
- webinar invite email + landing page
- A/B hero variants: (A) Ravi's tech quote, (B) impact quote: "Engineers spent time building features, not babysitting infra."

noel: HubSpot workflow snippet for ops:
```
Trigger: form submit -> set cs_source=northstar -> add to list cs:webinar-northstar -> if RSVP clicked -> tag cs:northstar-hot -> notify SF queue
```

marco: Action items:
- leah: confirm signed permission (done)
- ivy: draft assets + share drive link (EOD Thu)
- celeste: legal redline + embargo clause (Mon 11:00 PDT)
- noel: HubSpot workflow + UTMs + SF routing (this week)

marco: Also small ask  can we route inbound leads who view the case study but don't submit the form into a nurture sequence (3-email drip) with an early webinar invite CTA? Noel, can you add that as an optional step in the workflow?

noel: Yep. Add branch: if page view > 2 and no form submit within 7d -> add to nurture list `cs:northstar-nurture` -> send 3-email drip -> add to webinar list on click.

celeste: Clarity note for permission: include logo resolution use and headshot credit line exactly as client wants. Upload exact copy to the permission PDF.

leah: Ravi approved the headshot credit: "Photo: NorthStar Analytics" and approves the logo usage.

marco: Tagging @here for visibility :rocket: Let's keep the embargo tight and aim for clean lead routing so SDRs have a high-quality roster for the webinar.

upload-bot: Reminder: raw recording retained 90 days per retention policy.
